content.divergence_summary: Both branches encountered the same anchor on 2026-05-16: The canopy snaps sideways before noon; green hulls knock loose and roll under leaves while the air smells metallic. Main YY answered through immediate practical movement; feather-branch YY also carried the sign to Mira ledger.
content.branch_a_path: YY raced the wind for fallen green hulls, got bonked once, and came home before the branches started speaking loudly.
content.branch_b_path: YY read the wind line from Mira rock, then collected only what the gusts had already knocked free.
key_differences: Main keeps the encounter mostly private and body-first.
The feather branch makes the encounter legible through Mira without making it a performance.
Food stores and attention rise at different rates because the ledger route costs time.
shared_elements: The canopy snaps sideways before noon; green hulls knock loose and roll under leaves while the air smells metallic.
Both branches keep the event physical and local.
Neither branch creates a new fork; the day deepens existing patterns.
